newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Dubai spreads firm as wet market supply tightens.
newsitem.headline: Dubai spreads firm as wet market supply tightens.

text.p: Dubai intermonth spreads firmed on Friday in Asia as the physical market for March barrels tightened, traders said.
March/April spread was indicated at 39/50 cents per barrel and twice traded overnight at +42 cents.
This compared with 35/40 cents in Asia and in London on Thursday. However, the spread had started to firm in New York.
Traders said they believed all of March Dubai cargoes had now been placed with the exception of one cargo, which was held by a European major.
The tight March market comes a week before India is scheduled to award its March import tender. The tender closes on January 30 and offers should be valid until January 31.
In the February tender, India was offered 10 Dubai cargoes, but in the end awarded only one.
It regularly awards Dubai in its monthly tenders.
Traders said the latest trades in the wet market have been at full-month quotes +51, +53 and +59 cents. The final deal was done between a Wall Street trader and a U.S. major, traders said.
